reviews.title: Greedy
reviews.body: While this seems like a great app with many helpful tools, the $6.99/WEEK price is actually disgusting and insane. I could 100% get behind $6.99/month, but per week is downright greedy. These tools should not be hidden behind a paywall, especially not one that steep. If the developers of this app actually wanted to help people grow their faith and learn about the bible, they would not do this. I understand that if you pay the yearly price, it’s cheaper but not everyone has $60 to put towards this all at once. It is especially discouraging considering how many people of faith are impoverished or at the very least, struggling with either finances or mental health. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Charging to use
reviews.body: I love this app and i use it eveynight to pray. It truly does deepen my relationship with God. Now they are charging a fee for users to go back and do the prayer for the night before. This is important to me because i pray every night before bed and sometimes it gets past 12 so i would do my prayer for the night before. Now the prayer is locked so i cant pray and my 172 day streak is loss. I feel that making the users pay to pray isn’t fair and God wouldn’t be happy about this. To me it feels like greed and they are just using christian’s for their money when they just want to get closer to God.

reviews.title: Loved before update now being charged for things that were part of subscription kinda money grab
reviews.body:
I really enjoyed this app. One of the perks was the streaks being a paid subscriber. You would not lose your streaks and you could actually go back and read if something came up and you missed a day  or were sick for a couple of days you wouldn’t lose your streak entirely now even with subscription you cannot go back and view what you’ve missed and you have to pay for the “frozen “ days whatever that is. I think the update happened in August. I’m not 100% sure but I don’t think I’m going to continue when my subscription comes to an end, this is something that really motivated me to stay reading and it was a challenge to myself keeping the streak. I have so many moving parts of my life being a primary care caregiver for my elderly grandmother, a single mom with three kids and I own my own business so time is not something I have abundance of, however I do want to make more time for reading scripture and the streak encouraged and challenged me but if I miss a day and lose everything kind of makes you want to just stick with a free app instead so not to be  discouraged bc that’s not what this app should invoke 


Overall, I think it’s un fair to charge people who have a subscription for something that we were originally getting.

Also not sure why the whole layout changed entirely .  I’d consider leaving the option for us to pick to update or go back to previous view if we preferred it .  Too many changes overall
